data.body: Ticket 1 (ADR): change 2441 patchset 1 got Verified-1 -- docs-only-route CI gate "ADR-number bijection" failed: missing docs/adr/.numbers/0108 marker file. Root cause: docs/adr/README.md and .numbers/ markers are generated artifacts (scripts/gen_adr_index.py), not hand-edited -- my manual README.md edit was correct in content but wrong mechanically (missing the marker + generator's own formatting/section placement, which files by slug keyword and put this ADR in "Other decisions" since "retire-severity-label" doesn't match the Code-review bucket's keyword list). Fixed by running gen_adr_index.py locally, verified all local docs gates green (check_adr_numbers, gen_adr_index --check, check_docs_index, check_readme_quickstart, check_criteria_vocabulary all exit 0), amended commit 0081c81 (Change-Id preserved), re-pushed patchset 2 to https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2441.
